verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-request mail scanning, PDF storage in unlimited cloud storage, and tagging mail 'so it's easier to find later', and registered-agent documents are stored so you can 'find and organize' them. That gives a scanned, findable archive, but nothing shows OCR or search by sender, content, or date. Missing for 10: any mention of OCR/text extraction, full-text content search, search or filtering by sender and date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
